originalTitle: $20 billion bet: Where is Warren Buffett's successor spending Berkshire's cash pile after 14 quarters?
simplifiedContent: Warren Buffett's company, Berkshire Hathaway, has started buying more stocks than it's selling for the first time in 14 quarters, now that Greg Abel is in charge. This means the company is investing a lot of money in the stock market, specifically $20 billion in new stocks and $4.5 billion in buying back its own shares. Berkshire Hathaway has added a new company, Alphabet, to its top five favorite stocks, which also includes well-known companies like Apple and Coca-Cola. This is significant because it shows the company's new investment strategy under Greg Abel's leadership. The big spending suggests that Berkshire Hathaway is optimistic about the stock market and wants to put its money to work.

originalTitle: Rs 7,681 crore IPO rush next week: Shiprocket, Milky Mist among 9 issues to hit the market
simplifiedContent: Next week, nine companies in India are planning to raise a total of Rs 7,681 crore by selling shares to the public for the first time, known as an Initial Public Offering (IPO). This is a big event in the stock market, with companies like Shiprocket, Milky Mist Dairy Food, and Molbio Diagnostics participating. The IPOs will start on August 10 and 12, which means people can start buying shares on these days. This is significant because it shows that many companies are looking to raise money from investors, and it can be an opportunity for individuals to invest in these companies. The rush of IPOs may also affect the overall stock market, as eight other companies that issued IPOs last week are now set to list their shares.

originalTitle: Berkshire Hathaway spends down cash pile under CEO Greg Abel
simplifiedContent: Berkshire Hathaway, a big company led by CEO Greg Abel, used some of the money it had saved up to invest in other things. The company had a lot of cash, but now it has $365.5 billion, which is less than it had before. It spent $4.5 billion buying back its own stock and almost $20 billion investing in other companies, such as Alphabet and Taylor Morrison. The company's operating earnings, which is a measure of how well its businesses are doing, increased by 16% to almost $13 billion. This matters because it shows that the company is using its money to try to make more money, which could be good for investors.

originalTitle: Upcoming IPOs: Shiprocket IPO, Dhoot Transmission IPO among new issues to open next week; full list here
simplifiedContent: Some companies, including Shiprocket and Dhoot Transmission, are planning to sell their shares to the public for the first time through an Initial Public Offering (IPO). This is important because it gives you new options to invest in the stock market, and you can consider buying shares of these companies if you're interested.

originalTitle: Defence stock Apollo Micro Systems declares Q1 results 2026. Revenue jumps 88% YoY to  ₹251 crore, PAT up 43%
simplifiedContent: Apollo Micro Systems, a company that makes products for the defense industry, just released its financial results for the first quarter of 2026. The company's revenue, which is the amount of money it made from selling its products, increased by 88% compared to the same time last year, reaching ₹251.3 crore. The company's net profit, which is the amount of money it made after paying all its expenses, also increased by 43% to ₹25.2 crore. This is a significant increase and shows that the company is performing well. This matters because it can affect the company's stock price and influence investors' decisions to buy or sell the stock.

originalTitle: Q1 results 2026: Vodafone Idea to RVNL among companies to declare Q1 results next week; check full list here
simplifiedContent: Next week, several big companies will announce how they did financially in the first quarter of 2026. This includes companies like Vodafone Idea, Bharat Forge, and Tata Motors. These announcements, called Q1 results, will show how much money the companies made and lost during the first quarter. This matters because it can affect the price of their stocks, which can impact investors who own those stocks. The list of companies announcing their results includes other notable names like MRF, Rail Vikas Nigam, and Hindustan Aeronautics.
